Private legacy full-control builds of SurfaceProFanControl may include
WinRing0x64.sys from the OpenLibSys/WinRing0 distribution as carried by
OpenHardwareMonitor/NoteBook FanControl. The public portable package and public
source tree do not include this driver.

OpenHardwareMonitor source code is licensed under the Mozilla Public License
2.0. WinRing0/OpenLibSys is redistributed under its upstream license terms.

Upstream projects:
https://openlibsys.org/
https://github.com/openhardwaremonitor/openhardwaremonitor
https://github.com/hirschmann/nbfc

In a legacy full-control build, the signed driver is registered as a persistent
demand-start kernel service. The auto-start LocalSystem SurfaceProFanGuard
service depends on it, so Windows loads it when the guard starts.
SurfaceProFanControl pins and verifies the driver SHA-256 before configuration;
closing the UI does not remove the service. Microsoft classifies WinRing0 as a
known vulnerable driver (CVE-2020-14979), so these builds are not approved for a
public release.
